# Kongono Framework — Complete LLM Technical Reference (v1.20.0)

> Single-file, verified technical reference for AI coding agents (Claude, GPT, Gemini, Groq, Cursor, Codex, Antigravity) building and maintaining Kongono PHP 8.5+ applications.
> Every namespace, class name, and pattern below is verified against `kongono/framework`.

---

## 0. Non-Negotiable Architecture Rules

1. **Pure PHP 8.5.13+:** Always begin every PHP file with `declare(strict_types=1);`. Use `final readonly class`, backed enums, and native attributes.
2. **Zero Legacy / Zero Symfony / Zero Global Facades:**
   - NEVER import `Symfony\*` or `Illuminate\*`.
   - NEVER call static facades (`Route::get()`, `Auth::user()`, `DB::table()`, `Cache::get()`, `Http::fake()`, `Carbon::setTestNow()`).
   - NEVER use ActiveRecord magic properties (`__get`/`__set`) or implicit lazy SQL loading.
3. **Persistent-Runtime First (FrankenPHP, RoadRunner, `kongo serve`, PHP-FPM):**
   - Zero mutable static properties anywhere.
   - Never read `$_GET`, `$_POST`, `$_COOKIE`, `$_FILES`, or `$_SESSION` directly (only `Request::fromGlobals()` reads superglobals).
   - Inject `Request`, `Session`, `Principal`, `ClockInterface`, `PdoConnection`, `CacheInterface`, etc. explicitly.
4. **Fail-Closed Security:**
   - Parameterized `QueryBuilder` only (unscoped `UPDATE`/`DELETE` throws).
   - Multi-tenant apps use `QueryBuilder::forTenant($tenant)` + PostgreSQL `RowLevelSecurity`.
   - Rich HTML uses `@safeHtml($html)` (`HtmlSanitizer`), never raw unescaped output.
   - Outbound HTTP uses `SafeHttpClient` (DNS-pinned SSRF defense).
   - Diagnostics/logs/AI prompts scrub secrets with `SecretScrubber` (`sk-*`, `sk-ant-*`, `AIza*`, `gsk_*`, `kgn_pat_*`, `whsec_*`, DSN passwords, JWTs, PEM keys).

---

## 1. Bootstrapping an Application (`app/bootstrap.php`)

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

use App\Http\HomeController;
use Kongono\Core\Config;
use Kongono\Core\EnvLoader;
use Kongono\Core\Health\HealthCheck;
use Kongono\Http\App;
use Kongono\Http\Dev\DevDashboardMiddleware;
use Kongono\Http\Dev\DevInspector;
use Kongono\Security\Middleware\SecurityHeadersMiddleware;

$baseDir = dirname(__DIR__);
EnvLoader::load($baseDir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . '.env');

$debug = filter_var(Config::env('APP_DEBUG') ?? 'false', FILTER_VALIDATE_BOOL);
$inspector = new DevInspector();
$health = (new HealthCheck())->check('runtime', static fn(): bool => true);

$app = App::create($baseDir, name: 'My App')
    ->config(['app' => ['debug' => $debug]])
    ->views(autoReload: $debug)
    ->recordIncidents()
    ->instance(HealthCheck::class, $health)
    ->instance(DevInspector::class, $inspector)
    ->controller(HomeController::class);

$app->middleware(
    new DevDashboardMiddleware($app, $inspector, hotReload: true),
    new SecurityHeadersMiddleware(),
);

return $app;
```

- Always create apps via `App::create($baseDir, name: '...')` (constructor is private).
- Call `->recordIncidents()` to record secret-scrubbed 5xx failures to `storage/incidents/*.json` for offline `kongo incident:replay` and `kongo incident:test` regression test generation.
- Register singletons via `->instance(InterfaceOrClass::class, $obj)` or container bindings.
- For zero-SMTP local email capture in `/_kongono`, bind `Kongono\Core\Dev\FileDevMailbox` (`DevMailboxInterface`) and pass `new Kongono\Mail\DevMailboxTransport($devMailbox)` to `Mailer` when `$app->isDebug()` is true.
- `App::create()` binds `ClockInterface` to `SystemClock` automatically; override with `->instance(ClockInterface::class, FrozenClock::at(...))` in tests.

---

## 2. Routing, Controllers & Attributes (`Kongono\Http\Routing`)

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Http;

use Kongono\Http\Request;
use Kongono\Http\Response;
use Kongono\Http\Routing\{CacheControl, Delete, Feature, Get, Idempotent, Middleware, Patch, Post, Prefix, Put};
use Kongono\Security\Attributes\{Authenticated, Can, MaxAiCost, MaxQueries, NoOutboundHttp, ReadOnlyDb};
use Kongono\Security\Middleware\{BearerAuthMiddleware, CapabilityMiddleware};
use Kongono\Security\Principal;

#[Prefix('/api/notes')]
final readonly class NoteController
{
    public function __construct(
        private NoteRepository $notes,
    ) {}

    #[Get('/', name: 'notes.index')]
    #[ReadOnlyDb]
    #[NoOutboundHttp]
    #[MaxQueries(3)]
    #[CacheControl(maxAge: 60, public: true, staleWhileRevalidate: 30)]
    public function index(): Response
    {
        return Response::json(['items' => $this->notes->recent()]);
    }

    #[Get('/{id:\d+}', name: 'notes.show')]
    public function show(int $id): Response
    {
        return Response::json(['id' => $id]);
    }

    #[Post('/', name: 'notes.create')]
    #[Middleware(BearerAuthMiddleware::class)]
    #[Authenticated]
    #[Can('notes.write')]
    #[Idempotent(ttlSeconds: 3600)]
    public function create(CreateNoteInput $input, Principal $actor, Request $request): Response
    {
        return Response::json(['author' => $actor->id, 'title' => $input->title], status: 201);
    }

    #[Get('/beta', name: 'notes.beta')]
    #[Feature('beta_notes')]
    public function beta(): Response
    {
        return Response::json(['beta' => true]);
    }
}
```

Controller handler parameter injection automatically resolves: `Request`, `Session`, `Principal`, typed route params (`int $id`, `string $slug`), registered Container services, and validated readonly DTOs.

---

## 3. Typed DTO Validation & HTML PRG Flash (`Kongono\Validation`)

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Dto;

use Kongono\Validation\Attributes\{ArrayOf, Between, Confirmed, Date, Email, In, Ip, Max, Min, NotIn, Regex, Required, RequiredIf, Url, Uuid};
use Kongono\Validation\ValidatableDtoInterface;

enum Plan: string
{
    case Free = 'free';
    case Pro = 'pro';
}

final readonly class SignupInput implements ValidatableDtoInterface
{
    /** @param list<string> $tags */
    public function __construct(
        #[Required, Uuid] public string $requestId,
        #[Required, Email] public string $email,
        public Plan $plan,
        #[RequiredIf('plan', 'pro'), Min(2)] public ?string $companyName = null,
        #[NotIn(['admin', 'root'])] public string $handle = 'member',
        #[Date] public ?string $launchDate = null,
        #[Ip] public ?string $allowlistIp = null,
        #[ArrayOf('string', min: 1, max: 5)] public array $tags = ['php85'],
        #[Required, Min(12)] public string $password = '',
        #[Required, Confirmed('password')] public string $passwordConfirmation = '',
    ) {}

    /** @return array<string, string|list<string>> */
    public function validate(): array
    {
        if (str_ends_with($this->email, '@blocked.test')) {
            return ['email' => 'Domain is not allowed.'];
        }

        return [];
    }
}
```

- Implement custom reusable attribute rules with `Kongono\Validation\RuleInterface`.
- API requests failing validation receive `422` JSON (`{"error": ..., "fields": {...}}`).
- HTML form submissions with sessions can use PRG flash + `@old('field')` / `@error('field')` (sensitive fields are automatically stripped before flashing).

---

## 4. Views, Kongono Live 2.5 & Bridge (`Kongono\View`, `Kongono\Http\Live`, `Kongono\Http\Bridge`)

### Compiled `.kgn.html` Views
- `{{ $expr }}` — context-aware HTML auto-escaping.
- `@safeHtml($userHtml)` — sanitized through HTML5 `Kongono\View\HtmlSanitizer`.
- `@extends('layouts/app')`, `@section('content')...@endsection`, `@yield('content')`, `@include('partials/nav')`.
- `@if`, `@unless`, `@isset`, `@foreach`, `@forelse ... @empty ... @endforelse`, `<x-card :title="$title">...</x-card>`.
- `@t('key', ['name' => $name])` i18n, `@json($data)`, `@old('title')`, `@error('title')...@enderror`, `@vite(['resources/js/app.js'])`.
- `@liveScript` (Live 2.5 runtime), `@bridgeScript` (Bridge runtime), `@island('ComponentName', $props)` (hybrid JS island).

### Live 2.5 & Adaptive Responses
- Mount `Kongono\Http\Live\LiveMiddleware` for zero-build strict-CSP reactivity: `kgn-get`, `kgn-post`, `kgn-target`, `kgn-swap="morph"`, `kgn-oob`, `k-persist`, `kgn-sortable`, `kgn-stream`, and zero-`eval()` cached-AST signals.
- Mount `Kongono\Http\Bridge\BridgeMiddleware` for React/Vue/Svelte SPA pages (`Response::page('Orders/Show', $props)`).
- Serve all formats cleanly from one action:
  ```php
  return Response::adaptive(
      $request,
      html: fn(): string => $views->render('tasks/index', ['tasks' => $tasks]),
      fragment: fn(): Response => Response::fragment($views->render('partials/task-list', ['tasks' => $tasks])),
      bridge: fn(): Response => Response::page('Tasks/Index', ['tasks' => $tasks]),
      json: fn(): Response => Response::json(['tasks' => $tasks]),
  );
  ```

---

## 5. Database, Soft Deletes, BatchLoader, Factory & Migrations (`Kongono\Database`)

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

use Kongono\Database\{BatchLoader, PdoConnection, QueryBuilder};
use Kongono\Database\Schema\{Blueprint, Schema};
use Kongono\Database\Testing\Factory;

$db = PdoConnection::fromUrl($databaseUrl);

// QueryBuilder: parameterized SQL, tenant scoping, soft deletes, DTO hydration, pagination
$page = $db->table('posts')
    ->forTenant($tenant)
    ->withoutTrashed()
    ->whereGroup(static function (QueryBuilder $q): void {
        $q->where('status', '=', 'published')->orWhere('featured', '=', true);
    })
    ->orderBy('created_at', 'DESC')
    ->paginate(page: 1, perPage: 20);

$dtos = $db->table('posts')->onlyTrashed()->limit(10)->getAs(PostDto::class);
$db->table('posts')->where('id', '=', $id)->softDelete();
$db->table('posts')->where('id', '=', $id)->restore();

// Zero-N+1 eager relation loading (1 query per relation)
$commentsByPost = BatchLoader::hasMany($db, $page->items, 'comments', 'post_id');
$authorsById = BatchLoader::belongsTo($db, $page->items, 'users', 'author_id');

// Typed immutable factories (Kongono\Database\Testing\Factory)
$factory = Factory::for(UserDto::class, static fn(int $n): array => [
    'email' => "user{$n}@example.test",
    'role' => 'member',
]);
$admins = $factory->state(['role' => 'admin'])->count(3)->make();

// Schema DDL & evolution
Schema::create($db, 'posts', static function (Blueprint $t): void {
    $t->id();
    $t->uuid('public_id');
    $t->foreignId('user_id', 'users');
    $t->string('title', 200);
    $t->json('meta');
    $t->decimal('price', 10, 2);
    $t->timestamps();
    $t->softDeletes();
});

Schema::table($db, 'posts', static function (Blueprint $t): void {
    $t->dropSoftDeletes();
});
```

- For `CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY`, implement `Kongono\Database\NonTransactionalMigrationInterface`.
- PostgreSQL row-level isolation: `Kongono\Database\RowLevelSecurity`.
- Multi-database & read replicas: `Kongono\Database\ConnectionManager` (named connections + lazy factories + `resetSticky()`) and `Kongono\Database\ReadWriteConnection` (round-robin `SELECT` replica routing, primary routing for DML/`FOR UPDATE`/transactions, persistent-worker-safe sticky-after-write).
- N+1 detection in dev/tests: `Kongono\Database\QueryGuard`.

---

## 6. Full-Text & Hybrid RRF Search (`Kongono\Database\Search`, `Kongono\Ai\Embedding`)

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

use Kongono\Ai\Embedding\{HybridSearch, PgVectorStore};
use Kongono\Database\Search\PostgresFullTextSearch;

$fts = new PostgresFullTextSearch($db, table: 'docs', textColumns: ['title', 'body']);
$vectors = new PgVectorStore($db);

$hybrid = new HybridSearch($fts, $vectors, rrfK: 60, keywordWeight: 1.0, vectorWeight: 1.0);
$hits = $hybrid->search(
    queryText: 'FrankenPHP resetScope',
    queryVector: $queryEmbedding,
    limit: 5,
);
```

- `PostgresFullTextSearch` uses `tsvector` + `websearch_to_tsquery` + `ts_rank_cd` and emits plain-text `[[` / `]]` highlight markers (zero raw HTML XSS).
- In unit tests, swap in `Kongono\Database\Search\MemorySearchEngine` and `Kongono\Ai\Embedding\MemoryVectorStore`.

---

## 7. Auth, PATs, Gate & Security (`Kongono\Security`)

- **Cookie Sessions:** `Kongono\Security\Auth\SessionAuth` + `Kongono\Security\Middleware\SessionAuthMiddleware` + `#[Authenticated]`.
- **Revocable API Tokens (PATs):** `Kongono\Security\Auth\PersonalAccessToken` + `MemoryPersonalAccessTokenStore` / `CachePersonalAccessTokenStore` / `PdoPersonalAccessTokenStore` (SHA-256 hashed at rest, `kgn_pat_` prefix automatically scrubbed by `SecretScrubber`) + `BearerAuthMiddleware`.
- **Authorization:** `Kongono\Security\Gate` (fail-closed `define()`, `before()`, `policy()`, `allows()`, `denies()`) + `#[Can('ability')]` + `AuthorizeMiddleware`.
- **Account Flows:** `PasswordResetBroker`, `EmailVerifier`, `LoginThrottler`, theft-detecting split-token `RememberMeManager`, WebAuthn `PasskeyVerifier`, `MagicLinkAuth`, `PkceOAuthClient`, RFC 6238 `Totp`.
- **Crypto & Egress:** Argon2id `PasswordHasher`, HKDF v2 AEAD `Encryptor` (`XChaCha20-Poly1305` + `previousKeys` rotation), `TokenSigner`, `SignedUrl`, DNS-pinned `SafeHttpClient`, signed `WebhookDispatcher` + `#[VerifyWebhook]`, `AiThreatShieldMiddleware`.

---

## 8. Storage, Queues, Batches & Workflows (`Kongono\Storage`, `Kongono\Jobs`)

### Streaming Storage (`Kongono\Storage`)
- `LocalStorage`, pure-PHP AWS SigV4 `S3Storage` (paginated `ListObjectsV2`, server-side `x-amz-copy-source` `copy`/`move`, presigned URLs), `MemoryStorage`.
- Streaming I/O: `$storage->putStream($key, $stream)` / `$storage->getStream($key)`.
- Uploads & Downloads: magic-byte `UploadedFileStore`, `SignedLocalUrl`, multi-disk `StorageDisks`, `StorageFactory`, `Response::download()`, `Response::fromStorage()`.

### Queues, Batches & Workflows (`Kongono\Jobs`)
- Drivers: `PostgresQueueDriver` (`FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED` + fencing tokens), Lua-atomic `RedisQueueDriver`, `MemoryQueueDriver`.
- Priority draining: `$worker->run('critical,high,default')`.
- Atomic deduplication: `$queue->dispatch('sync', $payload, uniqueKey: 'tenant:42:sync')`.
- Middleware: implement `Kongono\Jobs\JobMiddlewareInterface`.
- Dead-letter replay: `listFailed()`, `retryFailed()`, `flushFailed()`, and CLI `kongo queue:failed`, `queue:retry`, `queue:flush`.
- Parallel batches: `Kongono\Jobs\Batch\JobBatch` + `BatchDispatcher` (`MemoryBatchStore`, `CacheBatchStore`).
- Durable workflows: `Kongono\Jobs\Workflow\WorkflowEngine` + `WorkflowContext` (`$wf->step()`, `sleep()`, `waitForEvent()`, `signal()`).
- Cluster-safe cron scheduling: `Kongono\Jobs\Scheduler\Scheduler` with `->withoutOverlapping(ttlSeconds: 300)` and `->onOneServer(ttlSeconds: 60)` backed by `AtomicCacheInterface` (e.g., `RedisCache`).

---

## 9. Global-Free Testing (`Kongono\Http\Testing`, `Kongono\Database\Testing`, `Kongono\Core\Clock`)

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

use Kongono\Core\Clock\FrozenClock;
use Kongono\Database\Testing\DatabaseTestHelper;
use Kongono\Http\Testing\{TestClient, TestUpload};
use Kongono\Security\Egress\SafeHttpClient;

$clock = FrozenClock::at('2026-11-22T12:00:00Z');
$clock->advanceSeconds(300);

// Outbound HTTP fake still enforces SSRF checks (blocks private/loopback URLs!)
$http = SafeHttpClient::fake([
    'https://api.partner.test/*' => ['status' => 200, 'body' => '{"ok":true}'],
]);

DatabaseTestHelper::inRollbackTransaction($db, static function () use ($app, $admin): void {
    $client = (new TestClient($app))
        ->actingAs($admin)
        ->withStatefulCookies()
        ->followRedirects();

    $client->postMultipart('/avatars', files: ['avatar' => TestUpload::fakePng('me.png')])
        ->assertCreated()
        ->assertJsonPath('status', 'stored');
});
```

---

## 10. AI SDK, 5 Native Providers, PromptGuard, Evals & MCP (`Kongono\Ai`)

### `AiClient::fromEnv()` Auto-Detection
Set any one environment variable (optional overrides: `KONGONO_AI_PROVIDER`, `KONGONO_AI_MODEL`):
- `OPENAI_API_KEY` (+ optional `OPENAI_BASE_URL`) -> `OpenAiProvider` (`gpt-4.1-mini`)
- `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` -> `AnthropicProvider` (`claude-sonnet-4-20250514`)
- `GEMINI_API_KEY` -> `GeminiProvider` (`gemini-2.5-flash`)
- `GROQ_API_KEY` (+ optional `GROQ_BASE_URL`) -> `GroqProvider` (`llama-3.3-70b-versatile`)
- `OLLAMA_HOST` -> `OllamaProvider` (`qwen2.5-coder:7b`)

```php
use Kongono\Ai\{AiClient, ChatRequest, Message};
use Kongono\Ai\Provider\GroqProvider;

$ai = AiClient::fromEnv();
// Or construct explicitly: new AiClient(new GroqProvider($_ENV['GROQ_API_KEY']))

$ai->chatStream(
    new ChatRequest([Message::user('Explain Kongono OperationScope')]),
    static function (string $delta): void { echo $delta; },
);

$dto = $ai->structured($ticketText, TicketSummaryDto::class);
```

- Prompt injection & canary defense: `Kongono\Ai\Security\PromptGuard` + `UntrustedInput`.
- Governed agents: `Kongono\Ai\Agent\AgentPrincipal`, `RequiresApproval`, `AgentRunner` (token & USD cost budgets).
- RAG: `Kongono\Ai\Embedding\KnowledgeBase` + `PgVectorStore` / `MemoryVectorStore` + `HybridSearch`.
- Evals: `Kongono\Ai\Eval\EvalRunner` + `php vendor/bin/kongo eval --redteam` + `php vendor/bin/kongo eval --companions` + `php vendor/bin/kongo eval --agent-bench [--live] [--export-jsonl=dataset.jsonl]`.
- Resilience & per-companion routing: `FallbackProvider`, `AiClient::fromEnvForCompanion()`, `KONGONO_{OSHIE,CHIE,HANTEI}_{PROVIDER,MODEL}`, `KONGONO_AI_FALLBACK_PROVIDERS`, `KONGONO_AI_MAX_COST_USD`.
- MCP: `php vendor/bin/kongo mcp` exposes **26** read-only, secret-scrubbed JSON-RPC 2.0 tools:
  - **Self-Verifying Proofs & Diagnostics:** `kongono_prove_all`, `kongono_diagnose`, `kongono_policy_check`, `kongono_incident_replay`, `kongono_perf_probe`, `kongono_prove_isolation`, `kongono_impact`, `kongono_shadow_diff`, `kongono_upgrade_plan`, `kongono_audit`, `kongono_eval`, `kongono_migrate_lint`
  - **Live App, Schema, UI & Docs Introspection:** `kongono_graph`, `kongono_routes`, `kongono_openapi`, `kongono_inspect_schema`, `kongono_search_docs`, `kongono_zokeibi_registry`, `kongono_test_route`, `kongono_sdk_generate`, `kongono_deploy_preview`, `kongono_list_files`, `kongono_read_file`
  - **AI Companions:** `kongono_oshie_lesson`, `kongono_hantei_diagnose`, `kongono_chie_preview`

---

## 11. Built-In `/_kongono` Dev Studio & `/_ops` Operations (`Kongono\Http\Dev`, `Kongono\Http\Ops`)

- **`/_kongono` Dev Studio (`DevDashboardMiddleware`, auto-disabled in production when `APP_DEBUG=false`):**
  - **Proof Center:** Runs `MasterProver` across all 5 verification pillars (`A+`..`F`) + live Incident Time-Machine replay & 1-click PHPUnit 13 regression test export.
  - **Zero-Build Hot Reload (`hotReload: true`):** `DevHotReloadWatcher` separates CSS fingerprints (`css_hash`, hot-swapped in-place without losing form state) from `.kgn.html`/`.php` code changes (`code_hash`), injecting `/_kongono/assets/hot-reload.js` only on `200 text/html` in debug mode.
  - **Built-In Dev Mailbox:** `DevMailboxTransport` + `FileDevMailbox` capture local outgoing `kongono/mail` emails with automatic `SecretScrubber` redaction, attachment badges, and sandboxed HTML iframe preview (zero SMTP/Mailpit/Docker).
  - **Read-Only Schema Explorer:** Inspects live SQLite/PostgreSQL/MySQL tables, columns, primary keys, and indexes without reading row data.
  - **Plain-English 5W1H Dev X-Ray vs. Zero-Leak Production:** In debug mode, errors render interactive What/Where/Why/Who/How-to-Fix cards; in production (`APP_DEBUG=false`), responses emit strictly vague messages + `KGN-*` Reference ID while full scrubbed 5W1H diagnostics log server-side.
- **`/_ops` Operations Dashboard (`Kongono\Http\Ops\OpsDashboardMiddleware`):** Mount with a `Gate` defining `ops.view` (read-only + 1-click Hantei DLQ diagnosis via `POST /_ops/queues/diagnose` using `DevStudioCompanions::opsJobDiagnoser()`) and `ops.manage` (dead-letter retry/flush), plus an explicit queue allowlist. Renders a zero-npm, strict-CSP Live 2.5 dashboard with queue depths, 1-click DLQ retry/flush/diagnose, `JobBatch` progress, `HealthCheck`, `Metrics::snapshot()`, and recent traces. Fails closed by default.

---

## 12. Self-Verifying Stack, Capabilities, Policies & Incident Time-Machine (`Kongono\Cli`, `Kongono\Security`)

### Least-Privilege Route Capabilities
Mount `Kongono\Security\Middleware\CapabilityMiddleware` (enforced pre-execution via `PdoConnection::guardBeforeQuery()` and `SafeHttpClient::guardBeforeRequest()`) and annotate controller actions:
- `#[ReadOnlyDb]` — blocks `INSERT`/`UPDATE`/`DELETE`/`DDL` statements before execution (throws `CapabilityException`).
- `#[NoOutboundHttp]` — blocks outbound `SafeHttpClient` calls from that route.
- `#[MaxQueries(N)]` — caps total SQL queries per request to prevent N+1 regressions.
- `#[MaxAiCost(maxUsd: 0.05)]` — caps AI spend per request.

### Executable Architecture Invariants (`app/invariants.php`)
```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

use Kongono\Cli\Policy\Invariant;
use Kongono\Security\Attributes\Authenticated;

return [
    Invariant::routesMatching('/api/admin/*', 'KGN-POLICY-ADMIN')
        ->mustHaveAttribute(Authenticated::class)
        ->describe('Admin API endpoints require authentication.'),
    Invariant::routesMatching('/webhooks/*', 'KGN-POLICY-WEBHOOK')
        ->mustVerifyWebhookSignature()
        ->describe('Inbound webhooks must verify cryptographic signatures.'),
];
```

### Closed-Loop Agent Verification Commands
1. **Unified Readiness Certificate:** `php vendor/bin/kongo prove [--json]` — runs 17-rule `diagnose`, `policy:check`, `prove:isolation`, `perf`, and PHP 8.5 codemod hygiene in one `A+`..`F` score.
2. **17-Rule Self-Inspector & Auto-Fixer:** `php vendor/bin/kongo diagnose [--fix] [--dry-run] [--json]` — checks controller/route/middleware/CSRF/Live/DTO/`.kgn.html` link/form/partial contracts and auto-repairs deterministic issues.
3. **Production Incident Time-Machine:** Enable `$app->recordIncidents()`, then inspect, replay offline in-process, and generate PHPUnit 13 regression tests via `kongo incident:list`, `kongo incident:show <ref>`, `kongo incident:replay <ref>`, and `kongo incident:test <ref>`.
4. **Change-Safety & Self-Upgrading Codemods:**
   - Semantic blast-radius diff: `kongo snapshot --out=baseline.json` then `kongo impact --against=baseline.json` (flags removed routes, dropped security attributes, breaking DTO changes).
   - Behavioral equivalence proof: `kongo shadow:record --out=golden.json` then `kongo shadow:diff --against=golden.json`.
   - Verifiable AST codemods: `kongo upgrade --plan` / `kongo upgrade --apply --verify` (auto-validates via `PhpToken::tokenize(..., TOKEN_PARSE)` + `diagnose` + `policy:check`).
5. **Continuous Watch & Zero-Dependency LSP:** `kongo watch [--once] [--interval=500] [--no-tests]` re-runs `diagnose`, `policy:check`, and PHPUnit on save; `kongo lsp` serves LSP 3.17 live diagnostics, 5W1H hover tooltips, and one-click Quick Fixes for `editors/vscode-kongono/`.

---

## 13. Essential `kongo` CLI Commands

```bash
php vendor/bin/kongo prove [--json]
php vendor/bin/kongo diagnose [--fix] [--dry-run] [--json]
php vendor/bin/kongo watch [--once] [--interval=500] [--no-tests]
php vendor/bin/kongo policy:check [--json]
php vendor/bin/kongo perf [--json]
php vendor/bin/kongo prove:isolation [--json]
php vendor/bin/kongo incident:list
php vendor/bin/kongo incident:show <KGN-REF>
php vendor/bin/kongo incident:replay <KGN-REF>
php vendor/bin/kongo incident:test <KGN-REF>
php vendor/bin/kongo snapshot --out=baseline.json
php vendor/bin/kongo impact --against=baseline.json
php vendor/bin/kongo shadow:record --out=golden.json
php vendor/bin/kongo shadow:diff --against=golden.json
php vendor/bin/kongo upgrade --plan
php vendor/bin/kongo upgrade --apply --verify
php vendor/bin/kongo lsp
php vendor/bin/kongo doctor
php vendor/bin/kongo routes --json
php vendor/bin/kongo graph
php vendor/bin/kongo openapi
php vendor/bin/kongo migrate --pretend
php vendor/bin/kongo migrate:lint
php vendor/bin/kongo migrate
php vendor/bin/kongo migrate:fresh --force
php vendor/bin/kongo queue:failed
php vendor/bin/kongo queue:retry --all
php vendor/bin/kongo work --daemon
php vendor/bin/kongo audit --attack --strict
php vendor/bin/kongo eval --redteam
php vendor/bin/kongo bridge:init
php vendor/bin/kongo bridge:types
php vendor/bin/kongo sdk:generate --lang=ts --out=sdk/client.ts
php vendor/bin/kongo deploy:init --domain=app.example.com
php vendor/bin/kongo optimize
php vendor/bin/kongo new my-app --starter=saas   # minimal | api | saas
php vendor/bin/kongo auth:init --mode=both       # web | api | both
php vendor/bin/kongo make:resource Post          # migration, DTOs, repo, controller, test
php vendor/bin/kongo make:job SendInvoice        # also policy|middleware|factory|rule|mail
php vendor/bin/kongo oshie --exercise routing
php vendor/bin/kongo oshie --progress
php vendor/bin/kongo oshie "Why is /api/notes slow?" --stream
php vendor/bin/kongo chie "Add a /api/stats endpoint" --interactive
php vendor/bin/kongo chie "Add a /api/stats endpoint" --apply --verify --rollback-on-failure
php vendor/bin/kongo chie "Now add pagination" --continue
php vendor/bin/kongo hantei fix --apply --verify
php vendor/bin/kongo hantei review --base=main --format=sarif
php vendor/bin/kongo hantei watch --log=var/log/app.log
php vendor/bin/kongo hantei history
php vendor/bin/kongo hantei queue-failed --queue=default
php vendor/bin/kongo eval --companions
php vendor/bin/kongo skills:install --target=both
php vendor/bin/kongo mcp
php vendor/bin/kongo check
```
